mapper.select: SELECT rp.id AS id, rp.version AS version, p.id AS perm_id, p.uid AS perm_uid, p.code AS perm_code, p.description AS perm_description, p.version AS perm_version, CASE WHEN rp.role_uid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS enabled FROM ${table_prefix_identity}rolePermission rp INNER JOIN ${table_prefix_identity}role r ON rp.role_uid = r.uid AND r.deletedDate IS NULL AND r.uid = #{uid} RIGHT JOIN ${table_prefix_identity}permission p ON rp.permission_uid = p.uid AND rp.deletedDate IS NULL WHERE rp.deletedDate IS NULL

SELECT ur.id AS id, ur.version AS version, u.id AS user_id, u.uid AS user_uid, u.userName AS user_userName, u.version AS user_version, CASE WHEN ur.role_uid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS enabled FROM ${table_prefix_identity}userRole ur INNER JOIN ${table_prefix_identity}role r ON ur.role_uid = r.uid AND r.deletedDate IS NULL AND r.uid = #{uid} RIGHT JOIN ${table_prefix_identity}user u ON ur.user_uid = u.uid AND ur.deletedDate IS NULL WHERE ur.deletedDate IS NULL

SELECT r.id AS id, r.uid AS uid, r.code AS code, r.description AS description, r.version AS version, COUNT(ur.id) AS numberOfUsers FROM ${table_prefix_identity}userRole ur RIGHT JOIN ${table_prefix_identity}role r ON ur.role_uid = r.uid GROUP BY r.id, r.uid, r.code, r.description, r.version LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
